_note_model_path: Animagine XL 4.0 (anime SDXL finetune) - the splash-booru recipe base for lw-gen, flipped from RealVisXL V5.0 (photoreal) 2026-07-11; see docs/GEN_MODELS.md. model_path MUST be the .safetensors FILE, NOT the tools/models/animagine-xl-4.0/ directory: from_single_file rejects a directory, and that dir holds a single opt checkpoint (not a diffusers layout). Loaded via AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_single_file (zero loader change from RealVis).
_note_controlnet: ControlNet-OpenPose SDXL (xinsir) for pose control. Pass --controlnet-pose <real splash> to extract a skeleton (natural pose + correct hand chirality) and keep sharp txt2img detail. Needs controlnet_aux (installed in .venv-gen).
_note_clip_model: MUST be the -quickgelu variant for the 'openai' pretrained weights: OpenAI CLIP was trained with QuickGELU activations. Plain 'ViT-L-14' + 'openai' warns 'QuickGELU mismatch' and degrades subject-QA accuracy (verified live 2026-07-10).
_note_resolution: MVP is 16:9 ONLY. Ultrawide/other aspects are deferred (a separate multi-target refactor); lw_gen_run refuses any non-16:9 aspect at exit 2.
_note_qa_calibration: Calibrated 2026-07-11 on a real Vayne candidate sweep (Animagine + ControlNet-OpenPose tuned batch, n=6 good + proto + official-skin + non-vayne anchors; scores recorded in docs/research/GEN_RETUNE.md). T_subj 0.26 = clean midpoint (good-min subject_cos 0.275 vs non-vayne-max 0.247; also correctly rewards canonical-default Vayne over off-canonical alt-skins). T_margin loosened 0.05 -> 0.045 (good-cluster min margin was 0.051, right on the line; 0.045 gives borderline-good breathing room and still rejects the observed 0.043 near-miss). T_blur raised 100.0 -> 150.0 from the seed placeholder: good-cluster lap_var 232-663, a mild r=1 Gaussian blur crashes lap to ~52, so 150 sits safely between (validated by a blur sweep on the sharpest candidate; reason correctly reports 'blurry' with subject still readable).
_note_T_aes: T_aes is currently a PERMISSIVE NO-OP. The aesthetic scorer (CLIP softmax over high/low-quality text) is non-discriminative on this content - every image (good gen, blurred, real photo, official skin) scores 0.500-0.504 (measured 2026-07-11). Keep T_aes well below 0.50; raising it toward the cluster would reject at random, not by quality. A real aesthetic/degenerate discriminator is DEFERRED (see GEN_RETUNE.md DEFERRED: aesthetic-predictor-v2).
_note_rc_live: Gate lists ONLY the VRAM-contending game/client processes. RiotClientServices.exe was REMOVED 2026-07-11: it is a background launcher service that lingers idle after the game closes and uses ~0 GPU, so gating on it would permanently block gen on any box with the Riot client installed (Vanguard vgtray/vgc are anti-cheat, never GPU, and are also excluded). Verified live: game closed + RiotClientServices resident -> nvidia-smi showed 554 MiB used / 11390 MiB free. The operator's locked hard-gate intent is VRAM contention by the actual game, which this list now matches. Future: a direct free-VRAM-threshold check would be a more robust gate.
